I recommend everyone try these kibble. However, you have to wait 6 to 8 weeks to see the benefits! I'm still continuing the Zenrelia treatment and washing her paws with Malaseb shampoo about every two weeks...

But no more corticosteroids or oral antifungals, which she couldn't tolerate anymore! (Vomiting/rapid heart rate)

Have a good day everyone.

I highly recommend them. My Shih Tzus love them and they're a perfect fit for them. Perfect digestion and less scratching, or even none at all.
Kibble received every 6 weeks, no delivery problems, my dog ​​had a lot of itching, but since I've been giving her Reglo kibble she doesn't scratch anymore.

My Yorkshire Terrier loves these kibble and no longer scratches his smelly ears!! (No ear infection according to the vet).

His stools are well-formed and regular.

He loves the taste, the size is perfect, and they're easy to chew.

I highly recommend them.
